description: Delegate Joe Vogel Endorses Congresswoman April McClain Delaney GAITHERSBURG, MD — Today, Delegate Joe Vogel officially endorsed Congresswoman April McClain Delaney for re-election to represent Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
